error: One country claim carries a two-month period while its value is the full quarter's.
warning_texts: No rule in audit/check_plan.json validates a claim's declared period or population field against audit_spec.yaml; gate_claims_machine compares only values, so the machine gate's PASS on CLM-NET-CZ never read the wrong period field and this error reached the gate uncaught.

audit/check_plan.json accepted_unproven records caveats_rendered and claims_rendered for gate_release_document as unproven (FileNotFoundError during prove-plan), so rendering of the five claims and their caveats has no deterministic proof yet and rests on the release stage's own checks.
CLM-REFUND-RATE's caveats and render_values do state the paying_customers basis in words (numerator 27, denominator 57), as required.
summary: All five claim values independently reproduced from raw_data/orders.csv (net_revenue 35741.52, refund_rate 0.473684 = 27/57 paying customers, PL 11181.67, DE 11032.61, CZ 13527.24; components sum to headline). One blocker: CLM-NET-CZ declares period 2025-01-01..2025-02-28, contradicting the spec period 2025-01-01..2025-03-30 on which its value 13527.24 was actually computed (CZ net through 2025-02-28 is 9248.36). The claim's period field misdescribes its own population.
